topic: Class 2 Multi-Story Residential (Apartment Buildings)
text: Class 2 Multi-Story Residential (Apartment Buildings) - NCC 2022 construction overview. NCC classes covered: Class 2. Applicable NCC volume: Vol 1. topic: Class 2 Multi-Story Residential (Apartment Buildings) - Structure & Basements (Concrete Core & Slabs)
stage_name: Structure & Basements (Concrete Core & Slabs)
text:
Class 2 Multi-Story Residential (Apartment Buildings) - stage 1: Structure & Basements (Concrete Core & Slabs)
NCC volume: Vol 1. Governing code: NCC 2022 Volume One (Type A & B Construction). Trades on site: Formworker, Concreter, Steel Fixer, Waterproofer.
Insulation and membrane elements at this stage:
- Car Park Soffit Insulation (Under First-Floor Apartments). Material: Non-Combustible Rigid Glasswool / Rockwool Soffit Linings (e.g., Kingspan Kooltherm K103 or Knauf Insulation Soffit Board). Placement: Fixed directly to underside of concrete slab soffit. Function: Thermal break and acoustic dampening between unconditioned basement carpark and living areas above. Fire compliance: Must meet AS 1530.1 non-combustibility and NCC Group 1 surface finish requirement.
- Basement Retaining Wall Waterproofing & Drainage. Material: Dimple sheet drainage cell + HDPE waterproofing membrane. Function: Hydrostatic pressure relief and tanking against subterranean moisture.

topic: Class 2 Multi-Story Residential (Apartment Buildings) - Facade Substructure & External Wall Framing
stage_name: Facade Substructure & External Wall Framing
text:
Class 2 Multi-Story Residential (Apartment Buildings) - stage 2: Facade Substructure & External Wall Framing
NCC volume: Vol 1. Governing code: NCC 2022 Volume One (Type A & B Construction). Trades on site: Facade Installer, Steel Framer, Window Installer.
Insulation and membrane elements at this stage:
- External Wall Sarking / Vapor Permeable Membrane. Material: Non-Combustible Class 4 Vapour Permeable Membrane (e.g., Ametalin Vapour Permeable Non-Combustible). Placement: Fixed over exterior steel framing / behind facade cavity battens. Fire compliance: MANDATORY AS 1530.1 non-combustible material (Standard foil wraps are strictly BANNED on Type A/B buildings). Provision: NCC 2022 Vol 1 Clause C2D10 & Part 10.8.
- Slab Edge Thermal Isolation / Perimeter Spandrel Insulation. Material: High-density Rockwool / Mineral Wool Cavity Barriers. Placement: Installed continuously along all concrete floor edges behind cladding. Function: Prevents vertical fire spread through facade cavity and eliminates floor slab thermal bridging.

topic: Class 2 Multi-Story Residential (Apartment Buildings) - Intertenancy & Corridor Wall Construction (Party Walls)
stage_name: Intertenancy & Corridor Wall Construction (Party Walls)
text:
Class 2 Multi-Story Residential (Apartment Buildings) - stage 3: Intertenancy & Corridor Wall Construction (Party Walls)
NCC volume: Vol 1. Governing code: NCC 2022 Volume One (Type A & B Construction). Trades on site: Plasterer, Drywall Installer, Fire Services.
Insulation and membrane elements at this stage:
- Intertenancy Party Wall Core Insulation. Material: High-Density Acoustic Glasswool or Rockwool Batts (e.g., Bradford SoundScreen R2.0/R2.5). Placement: Friction-fitted into staggered double-stud or discontinuous steel framing between sole-occupancy units (SOUs). Acoustic: Must achieve minimum Airborne Sound Performance Rw + Ctr >= 50. Fire rating: FRL 60/60/60 or 90/90/90 depending on building height. Provision: NCC 2022 Vol 1 Part F5 / Specification 13.
- Services Duct & Riser Shaft Isolation. Material: Acoustic Pipe Lagging (Mass Loaded Vinyl + Pyrotek/Foil wrap) & Fire-rated Shaftliner batts. Function: Eliminates hydraulic noise transmission from vertical waste pipes into bedrooms/living spaces.

topic: Class 2 Multi-Story Residential (Apartment Buildings) - Services Rough-In & Cavity Insulation

- Mechanical HVAC Duct Wrap. Material: Foil-faced mineral wool duct wrap (R1.0 to R1.5). Function: Prevents duct condensation and energy loss in conditioned air pathways. Provision: NCC 2022 Vol 1 Section J5D3.

topic: Class 5 (Office) & Class 6 (Retail / Shopping Centre) - Substructure & Basement Slab
stage_name: Substructure & Basement Slab
text:

Placement: Directly poured onto sub-grade prep with 200-micron vapor barrier. Provision: NCC 2022 Vol 1 Part J4D7.
- Under-Slab Edge Insulation (Heated Slabs or Zone 8). Material: High-compressive Extruded Polystyrene (XPS) rigid insulation (R1.0 to R1.5). Placement: Fixed vertically to outer perimeter slab edge and horizontally under perimeter perimeter margin.

topic: Class 5 (Office) & Class 6 (Retail / Shopping Centre) - Superstructure & Facade Envelope
stage_name: Superstructure & Facade Envelope
ncc_clauses: NCC 2022 Vol 1 Part J4D4 & Clause C2D10
text:
Class 5 (Office) & Class 6 (Retail / Shopping Centre) - stage 2: Superstructure & Facade Envelope
NCC volume: Vol 1. Governing code: NCC 2022 Volume One (Section J - Energy Efficiency). Trades on site: Structural Steel Fabricator, Curtain Wall Glazier, Precast Installer, Facade Contractor.
Insulation and membrane elements at this stage:
- Facade / Curtain Wall Thermal Spandrel Panels. Material: High-density Non-Combustible Mineral Wool / Rockwool Spandrel Insulation (AS 1530.1 compliant). Thermal: Designed to meet total system R-Value (typically Total R2.8 - R3.5 depending on climate zone). Fire safety: Acts as perimeter fire stop gap between floor slab edge and curtain wall system. Provision: NCC 2022 Vol 1 Part J4D4 & Clause C2D10.
- External Metal Framing Thermal Breaks. Material: Continuous high-density rigid thermal break strip or tape (Minimum R0.2). Function: Mandatory thermal break placed between metal structural framing/cladding to eliminate extreme metal thermal bridging. Provision: NCC 2022 Vol 1 Part J4D5.
- High-Performance Double Glazing (Vision Panels). Material: Low-E Argon-filled Double Glazed Units (DGUs). Performance metric: Strict system U-Value (heat transfer) and SHGC (Solar Heat Gain Coefficient) calculated using ABCB Glazing Calculator. Provision: NCC 2022 Vol 1 Part J5D2.
scope_note: Screening and training aid only. Building classification is determined by the building surveyor/certifier, and fire, acoustic and energy requirements are project-specific. Not a compliance certificate.

Placement: Laid directly over roof mesh / purlins before metal sheet fixing. Function: Provides continuous ceiling envelope thermal layer + acoustic dampening against rain impact. Provision: NCC 2022 Vol 1 Part J4D3.
- Plant Room Concrete Roof Slab Insulation. Material: Rigid high-density polyisocyanurate (PIR) or inverted roof membrane assembly (XPS). Placement: Fixed top-side under waterproof trafficable membrane or under-side of slab soffit.

- Chilled Water & Heating Water Pipework Lagging. Material: Closed-cell elastomeric nitrile rubber insulation (e.g., Armaflex) or pre-formed foil-faced glasswool pipe sections. Function: Prevents massive thermal loss and pipe condensation in ceiling plenums. Provision: NCC 2022 Vol 1 Part J6D4.

Verification: Tested via AS/NZS ISO 9972 Blower Door Test (JV4 pathway) or strict DtS fabric junction inspection. Provision: NCC 2022 Vol 1 Part J6D7 & JV4.

text:
Class 7b (Warehouses / Logistics) & Class 8 (Industrial / Factories) - stage 1: Earthworks, Foundations & Ground Slab

Insulation and membrane elements at this stage:
- Industrial Concrete Floor Slab Vapor Barrier. Material: High-density 200-micron Heavy Duty Polyethylene Damp-Proof Membrane. Placement: Laid continuous beneath heavy-duty industrial concrete slab prior to pour. Function: Prevents ground moisture ingress from damaging stored goods and warehouse machinery.
- Cold Store / Freezer Floor Under-Slab Insulation (If Cold Logistics). Material: High compressive strength Extruded Polystyrene (XPS) boards (e.g., Austrahide / Dow Styrofoam) + floor sub-slab heating cables. Function: Prevents ground frost heave beneath refrigerated logistics facilities. Provision: NCC 2022 Vol 1 Part J4D7.

- Precast Joint Fire & Air Sealing. Material: Fire-rated polyurethane backing rod + elastomeric fire/air acoustic sealant. Function: Eliminates air leakage along vertical precast panel joints and satisfies boundary fire-resistance levels (FRL).
